stem:
Two stores are having sales on cameras.

• At Store X all cameras are on sale for 15% off the original price.

• At Store Y all cameras are on sale for \frac{1}{5} off the original price.

Which store would have the better sale price for a camera with an original price of $80?

options.label: A
options.text: Store X, because the sale price would be $68

options.label: B
options.text: Store Y, because the sale price would be $64

options.label: C
options.text: Store X, because the sale price would be $12

options.label: D
options.text: Store Y, because the sale price would be $16
